qadaa.title: Iṣumen ara teqḍeɛ
qadaa.reminderTextActive: Mazal-ak ussan n uṣum ara teqḍeɛ. Sefrek uḍfar-ik s wudem i k-yelhan.
qadaa.reminderTextIdle: Ma d-ffɣen ussan imaynuten, ad k-nini deffir Ṛamḍan.
qadaa.aboutText: Ussan n uṣum i ixuṣṣen ɣef lḥiḍ deg Ṛamḍan ilaq ad ten-teqḍeɛ ticki. Ṛebbi ieɛlem.

qadaa.undoCompletionMessage_other: {{title}}: {{count}} n wussan yettwaqḍaɛen ad uɣalen ɣer uṣebbaḥ-ik.
qadaa.helpParagraph1: Tigemmi-a tettɛawan-ik ad tḍefṛeḍ ussan n uṣum i ixuṣṣen ɣef lḥiḍ deg Ṛamḍan.
qadaa.helpParagraph2: Ussan yettwafen s wudem awurman d wid i d-yekkan seg uḍfar n lḥiḍ-ik deg Ṛamḍan. Tzemreḍ daɣen ad tarnuḍ ussan s yiman-ik, ula d iqburen. Mi teqḍeɛ ass, rcem-it am wayen yemmden akken ad yili uḍfar n wussan i yeqqimen d ameɣtu.
qadaa.ledger.surplusNote_one: {{count}} ass yettwaqḍaɛ ugar n useḍḍi n tura. Yeqqim deg uglam: tzemreḍ ad t-tekkseḍ seg umazray.
qadaa.ledger.surplusNote_other: {{count}} n wussan yettwaqḍaɛen ugar n useḍḍi n tura. Ad qqimen deg uglam: tzemreḍ ad ten-tekkseḍ seg umazray.
